name: Mask of Vengeance (The Blushing Mermaid)
backstory: Mask of Vengeance is a Human member of Auntie Ethel's flock. He can be found in The Blushing Mermaid alongside Mask of Servitude, Mask of Terror, and the real Captain Grisly.
